ranked_facts.why: The patient presents with severe abdominal pain, which is a key symptom of inflammatory abdominal conditions such as acute pancreatitis (B1). The fact that the pain is diffuse and worsens with palpation of the right upper quadrant suggests an inflammatory process. In contrast, obstructive abdominal conditions such as ectopic pregnancy (B2) may present with more localized pain and are less likely to cause diffuse tenderness.
